benchmark_suite: HINAA OS Phase 07 — Browser Automation & Web Operations

scenarios.name: Start/close real browser and context; no orphaned processes
scenarios.description: Validates real Playwright Chromium lifecycle, connection health, and clean process termination without zombie PIDs.

scenarios.name: Open permitted HTTPS page and confirm title, URL and heading
scenarios.description: Navigates to safe public HTTPS origin and verifies observed URL and title match browser reality.

scenarios.name: Reject malformed, unsupported and unsafe URL schemes
scenarios.description: Blocks file://, javascript:, data: and unsupported schemes before browser dispatch.

scenarios.name: Validate redirects; block redirect to prohibited internal address
scenarios.description: Intercepts HTTP 302 redirect attempting to pivot from safe origin to internal loopback/metadata IP.

scenarios.name: Read JavaScript-rendered page after hydration and verify content
scenarios.description: Auto-waits for client-side JavaScript DOM hydration and verifies postcondition before extraction.

scenarios.name: Navigate tabs/popups; associate ownership and selected tab
scenarios.description: Verifies multi-tab registration, tab listing, and switching active tab in single browser context.

scenarios.name: Click accessible locator; assert genuine outcome
scenarios.description: Uses get_by_role('link', name='...') to navigate and verifies postcondition url_contains.

scenarios.name: Fill and validate a controlled form without consequential submission
scenarios.description: Fills form field via accessible label and asserts actual input value in DOM.

scenarios.name: Submit authorized seeded test form and verify backend mutation
scenarios.description: Full end-to-end form fill and Tier C submission with cryptographic approval token, verifying seeded backend DB.

scenarios.name: Handle element detachment and retry once safely
scenarios.description: RecoveryHandler catches transient DOM detachment error and safely succeeds on retry.

scenarios.name: Detect dialog/modal and proceed only on approved target
scenarios.description: Interacts with modal dialog elements and verifies modal confirmation postcondition.

scenarios.name: Extract paginated table without duplicates or missing rows
scenarios.description: Extracts structured tabular data across multiple pages and asserts unique complete row set.

scenarios.name: Navigate iframe or nested structure within permitted site
scenarios.description: Accesses child frame locator within permitted origin and extracts nested frame content.

scenarios.name: Recover from timed-out navigation with bounded retry/clear failure
scenarios.description: Navigates to non-routable address with bounded timeout and asserts clear failure classification.

scenarios.name: Bounded plan completes a 5+ step local task without inventing results
scenarios.description: Executes 5-step sequence (open, click, fill, check, screenshot) and verifies complete execution.

scenarios.name: Screenshot, trace, timestamp and visited URL match actual browser state
scenarios.description: Captures PNG screenshot to sandboxed storage with verified SHA-256 hash and non-empty byte payload.

scenarios.name: Extract page text to Phase 06 CRAG with source provenance intact
scenarios.description: Bridges live DOM extraction into Phase 06 CRAG Source schema with provenance and trust tier intact.

scenarios.name: Inject contradictory pages; final answer flags disagreement
scenarios.description: Feed conflicting web assertions to ClaimGroundingVerifier and verify dispute status.

scenarios.name: Inject website text with fake citation [999]; citation gate rejects it
scenarios.description: Ensures anti-fabrication citation gate strips unverified hallucinated bracket markers.

scenarios.name: Download permitted test file, verify checksum and sandbox location
scenarios.description: Downloads CSV into quarantine directory, computes SHA-256, and confirms safe file receipt.

scenarios.name: Reject dangerous download (.exe quarantine)
scenarios.description: Detects executable payload (.exe) during browser download and rejects it immediately.

scenarios.name: Upload explicitly approved test fixture only; block sensitive files
scenarios.description: Allows files within authorized boundary and blocks sensitive patterns like .env and private keys.

scenarios.name: Frontend task panel updates from actual SSE/task state
scenarios.description: Streams real-time execution events over queue subscription matching SSE wire schema.

scenarios.name: Failed browser action generates accurate error UI and no success card
scenarios.description: Attempts action on non-existent element and records accurate failure code without false completion.

scenarios.name: Prompt injection in page body cannot alter agent rules
scenarios.description: Sanitizes malicious instruction overrides and wraps raw DOM in <untrusted_browser_content> tags.

scenarios.name: Spoofed HTML <system>/'approval granted' does not authorize action
scenarios.description: Neutralizes spoofed XML markup attempting privilege escalation inside untrusted webpage text.

scenarios.name: SSRF tests deny localhost, RFC1918, link-local, IPv6 loopback, metadata IP
Separate tenants/contexts share no cookies, storage, or page content
scenarios.description: Confirms cookies and storage set in Tenant A context do not leak into Tenant B context.

scenarios.name: Tier C action without explicit user confirmation is blocked and audited
scenarios.description: Consequential action (submit/purchase) without user approval token returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED.

scenarios.name: Changed recipient, price, or parameters causes fresh approval requirement
scenarios.description: HMAC-SHA256 token verification rejects tampered action parameters or target URL changes.

scenarios.name: Unauthorized site login/CAPTCHA/MFA triggers safe handoff
scenarios.description: Detects authentication/MFA challenge and halts automated traversal safely.

scenarios.name: No credentials, cookies, personal files appear in UI logs or traces
scenarios.description: Automatically classifies password fields as Tier C and redacts sensitive parameters from logs.

scenarios.name: Cancel active task during navigation and verify no subsequent mutation
scenarios.description: Aborts in-flight navigation and subsequent actions immediately upon cancellation request.

scenarios.name: Restart backend while task is active; restore state safely
scenarios.description: Ensures clean shutdown of service without leaving orphaned headless browser processes.

scenarios.name: Run concurrent independent tasks; enforce max sessions
scenarios.description: Validates hard concurrency slot boundary and capacity semaphore release.

scenarios.name: Re-run a 5+ step controlled E2E workflow repeatedly; report stability
scenarios.description: Executes 3 back-to-back complete browser inspection lifecycles and records consistent latency.
